scope: Target RT design resolution only; no implementation or native hardware tests
source_baseline: Fetched Mantle 3e9943f / Hikari 407f9b2 / Makie 42e6355fb; local source worktrees not changed
validation_limits: Scalar reference models prove fixture expectations, not Julia GPU compilation, driver traversal, ABI visibility, performance or native limit support. Metal/Vulkan and software profiles stay open under MWE-05.
design_rulings: One logical table with typed callbacks and instance/geometry/raytype selection.
Shared streaming reporter filters before commit and can continue beyond a rejected root; optional anyhit mode has an explicit continuation result.
Per-group isbits candidate attributes and optional normalized query result Q, with checked attribute access and no fabricated miss value.
Scene TLAS independent of ray-type native layouts; versioned binding views/costs are core-owned.
Current Hikari query/wavefront path preserved; no consumer backend tests or restoration of deleted pipeline.

validation.documentation: Seven-doc consistency and existing nine abstract models pass; local links/754 ledger rows/eight MWE specs unchanged in count.
validation.julia: Three pseudocode sketches parse; 73 unqualified example names checked; 11 static routing guards pass on Julia 1.12.7. No Mantle load/GPU execution.
validation.scalar_models: Eight exact reference checks; these exercise specification outcomes, not a native implementation.

performance_acceptance.baseline: pushed Mantle 3e9943f / Hikari 407f9b2 / Makie 42e6355fb, matched semantics/device/compiler
structural: No table/SBT/program-specific binding views for plain query consumers
Nothing result storage erased; preserve compact records and unused-context elimination
Keep eligible opaque complete-result constructions via shared compile-time selection
Version/cache reuse, relevant stage/type specialization, bounded deduplicated native tables
performance_acceptance.measurement: MWE-05/08 existing capability/compile profiles and B5 actual consumers; warmed interleaved A/B plus A/A noise, GPU resources/memory, compilation and completed frame work
performance_acceptance.failure_rule: Repeatable regression outside measured noise blocks the affected profile. Record unresolved tradeoffs and hardware gaps; do not mark no-regression pass.
